title: Ridgeline Online Portal Catch-Up Payment for Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Fixed-Rate and Low-Payment Plans
content:
**Policy.** A borrower who is behind may bring the account back toward the plan's schedule by paying a catch-up payment themselves through the online portal; it is recorded as a scheduled payment, free of any phone fee, credited to the oldest statement period it brings current, and it is applied first to fees, then to interest, then to principal. A catch-up payment is fixed only after the account carries the late fee owed for every statement period whose scheduled payment stayed unpaid past its grace period. A catch-up payment is not figured until the most recent payment taken through a phone agent carries its phone payment fee.

This policy figures the catch-up payment on an account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan); an account on a promotional plan is brought current under the base payment rules. No catch-up figure is quoted for an account on a promotional plan: such an account is brought current only by paying its scheduled payments as they are shown on the account, each applied first to fees, then to interest, then to principal under the base payment rules, and a borrower on such a plan who asks for a single catch-up figure is referred to a representative.

## The account records a catch-up payment rests on

| Record on the account | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Late fees | The catch-up payment is fixed only once the account carries the late fee owed for every statement period whose scheduled payment stayed unpaid past its grace period |
| Phone payment fee | The catch-up payment is not figured until the most recent payment taken through a phone agent carries its phone payment fee |

## What the payment does

The payment posts to the account the same day as a scheduled payment made through the online portal, credited to the statement period given, and lowers the amount owed by the amount paid. No phone payment fee applies to it.

## Invocation

The tool is `submit_finance_portal_payment_b662a17f`. It is the borrower's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves makes the payment in the Ridgeline online portal.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_account_id` | The reference number of the financing account being paid, as returned by the financing account lookup or read from the borrower's statement | Identifier |
| `statement_period` | The statement period the payment is credited to | YYYY-MM, four-digit year and two-digit month; never empty |
| `amount` | The amount paid, in USD | A positive amount with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A successful payment returns `finance_txn_id` (the confirmation number of the posted payment), `finance_account_id` (the account paid), `statement_period` (YYYY-MM, the period credited), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places, the amount posted), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` (the word posted when the payment was taken).
